Thank you for coming,
<name hero>.

You are, of course,
familiar with the three
pillars located on Ragol.

One's in the forest,
one's in the caves, and
one's in the mine.

And each of these three
had some sort of writing
on them.

Currently the Lab cannot
decipher the text. But
with new data...

The underground ruins
have more symbols that
could help us with this!

It might tell us the
reason behind the
explosion... the seal to
the ruins...

This writing must hold
the answers that we need!

Please, go and take some
data readings of the
ruin writing samples.

Ask Irene to give you the
details.
I'm counting on you.

Please speak to Irene,
my secretary.

The device has a limited
operating time.

Put it on your head, and
use it to take some
readings of the ruins.

You got readings from all
the ruin monuments?!

Excellent! Please, give
the device to Irene.

These samples should
allow us to decipher the
monument text.

Bizarre life forms...
The explosion...

Maybe the Pioneer Project
had a secret purpose all
along.

I'll need your
cooperation to solve this
mystery once and for all.

I'll be counting on you,
when that time comes.

going?

yet!

Thank you for helping us
again.

Before I get started,
please take this.

You'll need this device
to take readings of the
writing in the ruins.

Holding this up to those
monuments will let the
device analyze them.

I believe that the
Principal has already
said this, but

I'll explain one more
time, for your benefit.

Orders are to get some
data on the writing down
in the underground ruins.

A teleporter has already
been set up to take you
to the target area.

Come back here after
you've gotten enough
data readings.

automatically when you
reach the monuments.

That is all.

Apparently, the Lab has
also secretly been using
hunters to investigate.

What're they looking for?
If you find out, please
let me know, hush-hush.
Thanks a bunch!

devices won't function

Please give him your
report.
Welcome back!

Great! Thank you very
much!

rest up for now?

Analysis shows that those
ruins are from a totally
unfamiliar civilization.

Normally, I'd be excited
about such a discovery,
but in this case...

By deciphering the
markings on those stone
relics, we might be able

to learn something about
the seal to the ruins,
and about Ragol itself.

I just wonder whether if
ignorance is truly bliss
or not…

Ruins of an ancient
civilization, discovered
on Ragol --

The problem is that we've
found wildlife, but no
sign of sentient life.

Maybe the civilization
that built the ruins
wasn't from Ragol at all.

Pioneer 1 was also
probably inspecting
those ancient ruins.

You've found clues of
this during your own
investigation.
Hmph!

I don't know what it is
that they were looking
for, but with all these

hostile enemies, and
that explosion, it
couldn't have been good.
